summary: Fate Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $100,000,000 of common stock under its existing shelf registration, executed via a Sales Agreement with Leerink Partners dated November 5, 2026. Leerink acts as sales agent on a commercially reasonable efforts basis, earning up to 3.0% commission, with no escrow arrangement. Shares would be sold at prevailing market prices; the last reported sale was $2.09 on November 4, 2026. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch dilution pace and any selling pressure from ATM draws.
